# GitHub Project Metadata

This directory contains repository automation and collaboration templates for ZSEC.

## Contents

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [workflows/repo-checks.yml](workflows/repo-checks.yml) | Syntax, Python, advisory-feed, and Markdown-link checks. |
| [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md) | Bug report template. |
| [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md) | Feature request template. |
| [PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) | Pull request checklist. |

Keep repository automation deterministic and lightweight. ZSEC is security tooling, so CI should prefer simple checks that are easy for operators to understand.
